question.text: Individuals employed as research analyst can receive feedback from sales or trading personnel of brokerage division to:

answer.text: Change their recommendation based on client demand
Ascertain the impact of research report

explanation.text: The Logic: The proviso to Regulation 18(10) on page 278 of the NISM XV workbook permits feedback from sales or trading personnel of the brokerage division solely to ascertain the impact of the research report. The Trap: The exception is narrow and limited to impact assessment. Other purposes listed in the distractors are not supported by the proviso wording. Note: Source-backed by Regulation 18(10) proviso on page 278 of NISM Series XV Research Analyst Workbook (February 2026).
